item.title: The Back Office conversation with Karthik
item.description: I met Karthik Rangappa sometime around 2005. I was trying to sell him an international investing account. I remember going to his office, and we hit it off almost instantly. Later, he helped us build our first website through a friend. This was back when we were called Kamath Associates. He then came to work with us for a bit before going to France to pursue his master’s in finance. He came back and was working on financial education when, in 2013, I reached out and asked him to come build that piece for us.

item.title: The Back Office with Venu Madhav
item.description: I still wonder what made Venu Madhav call me back in 2006 to ask, “Is there something I can do?” At the time, there was zero line of sight, I couldn’t even guarantee him a monthly salary. Yet he walked away from a stable, well-paying job at HP to join me back when I was just a sub-broker at Reliance Money😬 Zerodha wouldn’t be Zerodha today without him running pretty much all of our operations, compliance, and more over the years.
